issues.legal_issue: Whether the finding that the employee failed to conduct periodical inspections was supported by evidence and whether the burden of proof shifted to the employee after inspection records were produced.
Whether the finding that the employee negligently failed to stipulate creation of an equitable mortgage over offered collateral security was supported by evidence.
Whether the High Court exceeded the limits of judicial review by reappreciating evidence and setting aside disciplinary findings supported by some evidence.
Whether the disciplinary penalty could be sustained on the charges proved despite other charges being unproved.
Whether the penalty imposed was disproportionate so as to shock the conscience of the court.
